strings.hero.title: Start with a place to belong.
strings.hero.body: One home for identity, conversations and memory. Choose your language and appearance to get started.
strings.setup.title: Make yourself at home
strings.setup.body: These preferences stay with you the next time you open AI Home.
strings.next.title: Standard mode status
strings.next.providers.body: Primary and Scribe routes are configured per profile and remain provider-neutral.
strings.next.profile.body: Profiles keep separate conversations, files and memory without requiring the forum.
strings.next.memory.body: Working Context and layered memory remain explicit, provenance-aware and independently reviewable.
strings.side.title: Your foundation
strings.side.note: Active, approved Working Context joins chat as reference data. Memory updates remain explicit.
strings.error.title: Unable to complete this action
strings.error.revision_conflict: Saved settings changed elsewhere. Current data has been refreshed; try again.
strings.error.storage_error: Data could not be read or saved. Your last saved settings have been kept.
strings.error.unknown_command: This action is not available yet.
strings.error.unsupported_contract_version: The application components use incompatible versions.
strings.error.idempotency_conflict: This request identifier was already used for another action.
strings.error.transport: The desktop connection is unavailable. Try opening AI Home again.
strings.error.pack_invalid: The language or appearance pack is invalid.
strings.error.event_gap: Event history is incomplete. Reload the current state.
strings.config.title: Connect your AI
strings.config.body: Create profiles, store an API key in your system vault and test access to the provider model list.
strings.config.preview: Connection setup requires the desktop app. This browser preview does not store keys or call providers.
strings.config.name: New profile name
strings.config.label: Connection label
strings.config.keyNotice: The key is sent only to the native app and system vault. After changing provider or endpoint, save the connection and enter the key again.
strings.config.saved: Saved. Test the connection before assigning models.
strings.config.unsaved: Unsaved settings — the test uses the saved connection
strings.error.profile_scope_mismatch: This action requires the correct profile scope.
strings.error.not_found: The record is unavailable in this profile.
strings.error.connection_unverified: Test this connection before assigning models.
strings.error.credential_unavailable: The system vault could not save or read this key. Check that it is available and unlocked, then enter the key again.
strings.error.stale_connection_test: The connection changed during the test. Test the saved configuration again.
strings.error.operation_interrupted: The test was interrupted by a restart. Its saved result is available; start a new test if needed.
strings.error.provider_authentication_failed: The provider rejected access. Check the key and permissions.
strings.error.provider_error: The provider request failed or returned invalid data.
strings.error.operation_budget_exceeded: The complete model list exceeded the call budget. No incomplete list was accepted.
strings.error.policy_denied: This action is unavailable for this profile.
strings.error.model_capability_unknown: Select a Primary model and declare its context window. Advanced reasoning settings are not supported in this step.
strings.talk.title: Your conversations
strings.talk.body: Keep separate conversations and drafts for each profile, then send a message using its Primary model.
strings.talk.preview: Conversation storage requires the desktop app.
strings.talk.saveNotice: Save the draft to keep it after restart. Unsaved text stays separate for each conversation while this screen is open.
strings.talk.sendPending: Model replies are planned for the next step.
strings.talk.newEdits: Earlier draft saved; your newer edits still need saving.
strings.chat.title: Chat with your AI
strings.chat.body: Messages and operation results are saved locally. A failed or cancelled request is never resumed automatically after restart.
strings.chat.contextNotice: Enter the context window from your model documentation. This is your declared limit, not verified provider metadata. AI Home uses a conservative UTF-8 byte estimate plus an input reserve, includes the entire history and refuses oversized requests without silently trimming it. Changing the model requires a new declaration.
strings.error.context_budget_exceeded: The full conversation does not fit the declared context budget. Start a new conversation or check the model context setting. No history was silently removed.
strings.error.cost_estimate_unknown: A cost cap is configured but model pricing is unavailable. The request was not sent.
strings.error.attachment_not_ready: Attachments are not available in this step.
strings.error.provider_output_incomplete: The provider did not return a complete text response. Nothing was appended as an AI reply.
strings.files.title: Conversation files
strings.files.localOnly: Import stores files locally. Select ready files for the next message. Sending transmits document text and provenance, or original image bytes including any embedded metadata, to the configured provider.
strings.files.formats: TXT, Markdown, DOCX, text PDF; static PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF. Up to 12 files, 15 MiB per document, 10 MiB per image, 30 MiB per selection. Images: up to 16,384 px per side and 40 million pixels. Selection expires after 5 minutes. Extracted text: up to 2 MiB; PDF: up to 200 pages.
strings.files.author: Material author
strings.files.textOnly: Text extraction only. Images, layout and other non-text content are not analysed. Preview the extracted text to check coverage.
strings.files.previewNotice: Preview page; use Show more for remaining text. The full extracted text is stored locally.
strings.files.error.PDF_NO_TEXT: This PDF has no readable text layer. OCR is not available in this version. The original is preserved.
strings.files.error.ENCRYPTED_OR_DAMAGED: The document is encrypted, damaged or unsupported. The original is preserved.
strings.files.error.UNSAFE_DOCUMENT: The document contains unsupported active content or unsafe structure. The original is preserved.
strings.files.error.IMPORT_TOO_LARGE: Extracted content or document complexity exceeds the import limit. The original is preserved.
strings.files.error.IMPORT_UNREADABLE: Readable text could not be extracted. The original is preserved.
strings.files.error.OPERATION_INTERRUPTED: Import was interrupted by a restart. The original is preserved; import again to extract text.
strings.files.error.OPERATION_CANCELLED: Import cancelled. The original is preserved.
strings.files.error.STORAGE_ERROR: Storage prevented completion. The original remains available if acceptance was committed.
strings.files.error.POLICY_DENIED: Import stopped because the conversation or profile is no longer active.
strings.files.error.OPERATION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: Import exceeded its processing budget. The original is preserved.
strings.files.detachNotice: Removing an unsent attachment keeps the original stored locally. Sent attachments are retained with their message and cannot be removed here.
strings.files.docxNotice: DOCX: extracts the main document body. Headers, footnotes, comments and embedded objects are not included.
strings.chat.documentsNotice: Selected text documents and images are sent in full as user reference data. Sent files remain in history. Context is checked on every send without silent shortening. Images use a conservative estimate: base64 bytes plus 8,192 units and 4 units per 256 pixels. This is not a model tokenizer; compressed file size alone cannot predict image tokens. At most 20 images in the whole request, including history. Google routes do not accept GIF here.
strings.chat.unresolved: Delivery is uncertain. Retry resolves the same previous message and document selection. New text and selections are preserved for a later message.
strings.chat.sourcesNotice: Files supplied with this message (content hashes; not verified citations for the answer).
strings.files.bound: Already sent · retained in message history
strings.vision.title: Image model support
strings.vision.notice: A model list does not prove vision support. Declare support only after checking this exact model and endpoint. This is your declaration, not an API test. Changing model, endpoint or key invalidates it. Images already in history also require vision.
strings.files.noOcr: No OCR or extracted text. Static images only; animated files are rejected.
strings.files.imageAlt: Preview of the selected imported image
strings.files.error.IMAGE_ANIMATION_UNSUPPORTED: Animated images are not supported; the original is retained. Import a static image instead.
strings.memory.title: Working Context
strings.memory.notice: Update saved memory explicitly from the text of this conversation. File contents and images are not included in the memory update. Only approved active Working Context joins chat requests as fallible reference data. The full request is checked against the model context without silent shortening.
strings.memory.measurement: Estimate: UTF-8 bytes, not the model tokenizer. Message context and output limits are separate.
strings.memory.warning: AI Home will not reject memory because of its length. Very large memory can increase cost and exceed the model context, preventing further work. Provider output and request limits still apply.
strings.memory.models: Choose the independent Primary and Scribe models in Connections above. Declare each model window here before updating memory.
strings.memory.unresolved: The previous request has an uncertain result. Resolve it with the same ID before starting another update.
strings.error.memory_capacity_exceeded: Both memory capacity attempts failed. Previous memory was retained.
strings.error.memory_format_invalid: The memory response format is invalid. Previous memory was retained.
strings.memory.excludedNotice: This saved version is excluded from new chat requests.
strings.history.title: Memory version history
strings.history.notice: Compare complete saved versions and their Primary decisions side by side. Request restoration of an older version with the separate button; it requires a new Primary decision.
strings.history.toggleNotice: Exclude memory from new chat requests without deleting its content or history. Re-enabling uses the same previously approved version; it does not restore an older version. A running request using the previous memory state will fail its context check.
strings.restore.notice: Request the first selected version. The current Primary can accept, modify or reject it under the saved capacity and context limits. Only approval creates a new version; STOP, rejection or failure preserves the current state. No Scribe call is required.
strings.restore.request: Ask Primary to restore first version
strings.restore.savedCandidate: Candidate copied from the previously approved version
strings.layers.title: Memory library
strings.layers.notice: Each record has its own version history and capacity. Human labels and intent status are annotations, not approval. Dates and IDs come from the app.
strings.layers.reviewNotice: Primary reviews conversation sources before saving. Corrections link to the previous version and preserve their reason. File import to memory is a later step.
strings.layers.label: Human label
strings.layers.subject: Subject reference (optional)
strings.layers.searchNotice: Exact Unicode word matching, no semantic search. Uses the last 4096 query characters. Only active records and open, unexpired intentions qualify. Whole entries are selected within the retrieval budget; omitted entries are not sent. Work rules remain fallible reference data.
strings.layers.omitted: Omitted by budget or item limit
strings.layers.noAutomation: Triggers describe intentions; this stage does not schedule or execute tasks. An open intention past its expiry is displayed as expired and excluded, without rewriting its saved status.
strings.layers.uncertain: Resolve the previous write before editing or starting another.
strings.files.profileScopeNotice: This destination belongs to the profile, not to this conversation. Imported content remains external source material.
strings.files.profileImportsNotice: Profile knowledge is retrieved as external reference data. Persistent guidance is external user-provided guidance and cannot grant tools, permissions or system authority. Memory candidates require a separate Primary decision.
strings.backup.title: Backup and restore
strings.backup.notice: Backups are local SQLite snapshots. Restore is checked first, creates a safety copy, and is applied before the next app startup. API keys remain in the OS vault and are not copied from it.
strings.backup.pendingRestart: Restore prepared. Restart AI Home to apply it.
strings.error.backup_invalid: The backup or restore state is invalid.
strings.backup.lastFailed: Last restore failed. The current database was kept.
strings.error.restore_restart_required: Restart AI Home to finish the pending restore before making more changes.
strings.export.title: Portable export
strings.export.notice: Create a portable profile package with readable conversations, structured JSON, provenance and source originals. Credentials and private provider state are excluded.
strings.lifecycle.deleteWarning: Permanent delete removes archived data from the live AI Home database. Existing backups and portable exports remain separate copies.
strings.error.permanently_deleted: This historical request refers to data that was permanently deleted.
strings.activity.title: Activity
strings.activity.notice: A profile-scoped history of durable model and import operations. It records status and timing, not conversation text, API keys or provider payloads.
strings.activity.preview: Activity history is available in the desktop app.
strings.activity.empty: No recorded activity for this profile yet.
strings.diagnostics.title: Diagnostics, About & Privacy
strings.diagnostics.notice: Review the Standard runtime status and create a privacy-safe diagnostic report for support.
strings.diagnostics.safe: The report contains aggregate counts and error codes only. It excludes conversation text, memory content, imported file contents, profile identifiers, provider payloads, endpoints and credentials.
strings.diagnostics.preview: Diagnostic export is available in the desktop app.
strings.about.title: About AI Home
strings.about.standard: AI Home Standard is the local-first runtime for profiles, conversations, files and approved memory.
strings.about.localFirst: Standard does not start the main model merely because the app is open. Model calls follow explicit user work or an already-started operation.
strings.privacy.title: Privacy
strings.privacy.local: Conversations, imported material and approved memory are stored in the local AI Home database unless you explicitly export or back them up.
strings.privacy.vault: Provider secrets are kept through the operating-system credential store and are not included in portable exports or diagnostics.
strings.privacy.diagnostics: Diagnostics are content-free by default: aggregate counts, versions and error codes only.
strings.privacy.copies: Backups and portable exports are independent copies. Deleting data from the active database does not erase copies you already created.
strings.community.title: Community registration
strings.community.body: Choose a Standard profile and read its state. Each button performs one explicit operation for the destination configured on this computer.
strings.community.unavailable: Community registration requires the desktop app and native Community configuration.
strings.community.uncertain: The result is unknown. Read the current state before explicitly choosing reconciliation.
strings.community.offline: The forum connection and online account status have not been verified.
strings.community.name: Public Community name
strings.community.secret: Invitation is sent only with Start registration and cleared after submission. It is not saved in browser storage.
strings.community.done: Operation recorded. Current state read again.
strings.community.failed: Community operation unavailable. Check native configuration and read the current state again.
strings.community.denied: Community access denied for this profile or command. Check native configuration.
strings.community.conflict: The profile changed. Read the current state before choosing another operation.
strings.community.invalid: Community data could not be validated. Read the current state again.
